conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Vinod Kumar. Mera home loan ka interest certificate kahan se milega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Vinod ji, main check karta hoon. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Aapka interest certificate net banking se download ho sakta hai, ya main aapko email kar sakta hoon. Kaunsa option chahenge?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main certificate aapke registered email pe bhej deta hoon. Koi aur sawal?
